notes.title: "GUROBU" new short horror game release!
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm excited to announce that I'm releasing a new game 
"GUROBU", which is a short experimental horror game about the haunting apartment featuring surreal dream sequences. 

It releases just in two weeks, on August 14th!

WISHLIST HERE!

notes.title: "Hedera" new horror game release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36230674/433af0b17477982c9fa6bda8a0056cb2a852540f.png

Hello, horror game lovers! I'm excited to announce that I'm releasing a new game "Hedera" on MAY 21st! 
It's all about dealing with past trauma through dreams\video games and features new mechanics such as taking photos, shooting, and more than 7 different endings!

Please, consider wishlisting the game! Thank you! :)

-Marx
